settings.title: Materials, finish & fit
settings.content:
Stainless-steel construction with gold-tone, silver-tone, or rose-gold-tone finish options. Chain lengths: 16, 18, or 20 inches.

Measure a necklace you already enjoy wearing to choose your length. The fit will vary with your neckline and body proportions.

Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth. Remove before swimming, showering, or applying perfume, and store separately.

settings.title: Is this necklace customizable?
settings.content: No. This necklace is sold in the listed designs. Choose your style, finish, and chain length above. There is no name entry, engraving, or coordinates personalization.

settings.title: Choosing a gift
settings.content:
A thoughtful choice for a birthday, an anniversary, or a just-because surprise. Choose a style marked “Rose Box” if you want the rose-style presentation box.

Need help choosing? Contact us before ordering.
